name: agent-escalation
description: 3-tier agent escalation engine — routes tasks to the cheapest effective execution tier before escalating to expensive GUI automation

tiers.name: Local Agents & Shortcuts
tiers.description: Default execution layer — handles 90% of workflows via APIs, scripts, and local automation. Cheap, fast, deterministic.

runtimes.name: n8n
runtimes.use_case: Webhook triggers, HTTP requests, conditional logic, scheduled jobs

runtimes.name: Apple Shortcuts
runtimes.use_case: Siri triggers, quick captures, share sheet actions, system automation

runtimes.name: AppleScript/JXA
runtimes.use_case: App automation, Omni suite integration, Finder operations

runtimes.name: Shell Scripts
runtimes.use_case: Git ops, Docker management, file processing, cron jobs

runtimes.name: MCP Servers
runtimes.use_case: Direct API calls to GHL, ClickUp, Stripe, Gmail, etc.

tiers.decision_rule: Can this be done via API, shell, AppleScript, or Shortcut? If yes, execute here. Never escalate what Tier 1 can handle.

tiers.name: Cowork + Dispatch
tiers.description: Long-running knowledge work in a persistent VM. Claude Cowork provides file access, connectors, and extended execution. Dispatch enables mobile control.

runtimes.name: Claude Cowork
runtimes.use_case: Research, coding, document synthesis, multi-file refactoring, PR workflows

runtimes.name: Claude Dispatch
runtimes.use_case: Mobile-initiated tasks, async work continuation, on-the-go commands

persistent_workspaces.name: eevl-research
persistent_workspaces.description: Eagle Eye R&D — competitive analysis, tech scouting, architecture design

persistent_workspaces.name: content-production
persistent_workspaces.description: Content writing, PDF synthesis, blog drafts, social copy

persistent_workspaces.name: code-ops
persistent_workspaces.description: Homelab code, Docker configs, M3TA OS development, agent refactoring

escalation_criteria: Task requires extended code execution (>5 min)
Task needs persistent file workspace across sessions
Task involves multi-file analysis or refactoring
User is mobile and needs async work continuation via Dispatch
Research tasks requiring iterative web search + synthesis
tiers.decision_rule: Is this research, coding, or doc work that needs a persistent VM? If yes, send to Cowork. If user is mobile, use Dispatch to submit/check.

tiers.name: Computer Use
tiers.description: Emergency / high-leverage GUI automation. Claude controls a screen — mouse, keyboard, clicks. Expensive, slow, use only when nothing else can touch it.

valid_use_cases.name: No API, high value GUI automation
examples: Batch retiming clips in Final Cut when scripting fails
Navigating vendor portal that only works in Safari to pull monthly PDFs
Complex settings UI for niche apps (one-off configuration)
Filling out government/vendor forms with no API

valid_use_cases.name: Fix broken automation emergency
examples: Vendor changes DOM, n8n workflow fails X times — Computer Use completes the urgent run manually
OAuth token expired on a weekend, need immediate workaround
Critical client delivery blocked by a flaky web UI
valid_use_cases.pattern: Orchestrator detects critical n8n failure → Cowork analyzes logs → if direct fix fails → Computer Use completes urgent run → schedule proper patch

valid_use_cases.name: Creator app deep UI interactions
examples: Complex plug-in configuration in Logic/Final Cut
Deep UI tree navigation in specialized production software
Multi-step import/export flows that resist AppleScript

scope_constraints: Single app or browser profile per session
Separate macOS user account for Claude ops
forbidden_zones: Email deletion or sending (read-only at most)

escalation_criteria: No API exists for the target application
AppleScript/JXA automation is impossible or unreliable for this UI
Critical workflow is blocked and manual intervention is the only path
One-time high-value task that would take human 30+ min manually
tiers.decision_rule: Is this a GUI-only task with no API/script path? Is it high-value enough to justify the cost? If both yes, escalate with strict guardrails. Always try Tier 1 and Tier 2 first.

escalation_flow.description: Every task enters at Tier 1. Escalation requires explicit justification.
steps: 1. Receive task from orchestrator or user
2. Check: Can Tier 1 handle this? (API, script, Shortcut, n8n) → Execute
3. If not: Check: Is this knowledge work needing persistent workspace? → Tier 2 (Cowork/Dispatch)
4. If not: Check: Is this GUI-only with no script path + high value? → Tier 3 (Computer Use) with guardrails
5. If none apply: Ask user for clarification
anti_patterns: Never use Computer Use for tasks that have an API
Never let Computer Use become the daily path — it is the emergency path
Never skip Tier 1 because Tier 3 'seems easier'
Never allow Computer Use sessions without time limits
Never give Computer Use access to sacred/financial data

security_rings.description: Concentric security boundaries — treat the machine like a temple

outer_ring.name: Cloud & VMs
outer_ring.scope: Cowork VMs, Computer Use sandboxes, Docker containers
outer_ring.rule: No direct access to host system. Sandboxed execution only.

middle_ring.name: Controlled folders & apps
middle_ring.scope: Dedicated macOS user, separate browser profile, project folders only
middle_ring.rule: Limited file access. Minimal saved credentials. Audit trail on all actions.

inner_ring.name: Sacred data
inner_ring.rule: NEVER allow automated access. Manual, conscious action only.
